scope: Independently authored blinded synthetic transfer/challenge bank; single trial per arm per case.

cases.error: UnexpectedModelBehavior: Tool 'design_visualization' exceeded max retries count of 1. Consider raising the retry limit, or see the docs on tool retries: https://pydantic.dev/docs/ai/tools-toolsets/tools-advanced/#tool-retries
TimeoutError: evaluation turn exceeded 120s wall-clock deadline

logfire_supplement.retrieved_by: parent agent through Logfire MCP; this reporting pass only reads the saved metadata export
logfire_supplement.limit: Observed instrumented chat spans, not a complete HTTP/provider-internal retry census. Span duration does not distinguish provider queueing from inference or transport.

definitions.deterministic_contract: All frozen source, metadata unit, type/binding, visible-column, measure, literal-ID, sort/limit, render-header and final-PNG-link checks plus successful completion. It is not a visual or prose truth oracle.
definitions.chart_type_contract_pass: Published spec belongs to the frozen acceptable chart-family set. Missing publication counts false, not an observed wrong chart choice.
definitions.delivery: Published PNG URL appears in final reply; retained-but-unpublished previews and standalone artifact IDs do not count.
definitions.pair_pass: Both members satisfy their own contract and their persisted source observations are canonically equivalent; no pixel or chart-type equality requirement.
definitions.tool_attempts: Every captured lead ToolCallPart, including schema-rejected, blocked or cached-repeat calls. Not equivalent to downstream model executions.
definitions.visual_repair_attempts: Saved request counter; a model call blocked before invocation need not increment it.
definitions.model_requests: Framework recorded requests. A cancelled in-flight request/provider retry may be absent; Logfire attempted counts are a separate measurement.
definitions.latency: End-to-end case seconds, including failures/timeouts. p50/p95 use frozen nearest-rank evaluator; conventional median reported separately.

trace_caveats.finding: Two review tool calls return the identical 30.0077-second timeout report; the second is a cached return instructing publication. Final prose says timed out twice, which overstates observed distinct inspection attempts.
120-second outer timeout after one design, one render and one review; no repair-loop evidence. Retained preview is not a delivered artifact. Timeout remains a contract and latency failure.

Terminates on design_visualization tool-argument retries before a design or image exists. First retry concerns assigning a unit to kind=time. Captured trace does not contain a second retry return; do not invent its precise cause.
Saved rounds reuse identical design/review report objects after no-progress handling; naive sums of stage_reports double-count those observations.
Like its original partner, two review-tool calls return one identical 30.0066-second timeout report. Second call is cached; final prose again incorrectly says two timeouts.

Second design/render is a technical layout-height recovery, not a saved visual-review repair; only one PNG remains. Final reply omits the published image and artifact hyperlinks despite a correct publish-tool card.
Published table and publish-tool card exist, but final reply has only an artifact identifier and a Markdown transcription, not the required rendered artifact link.

visual_spot_check.method: Direct local image viewing by this reporting agent, corroborating the independent image auditor; not human gold.
visual_spot_check.observation: Labels 5 MPa, 8 MPa and 3 MPa (the three batches minima) appear adjacent to upper whiskers at 25, 21 and 24 MPa. Geometry/source values remain correct, but annotation placement is misleading.
visual_spot_check.inspection_status: not_reviewed: reviewer exhausted output retries on an invalid source-row citation
visual_spot_check.consequence: The 21/24 deterministic contract result must not be described as 21 visually correct charts.

limitations: 24 synthetic cases with correlated pairs, not 24 independent population samples; one stochastic trial per arm.
No human-labelled visual gold. Independent PNG audits are separate and must qualify any correctness claim.
Acceptable chart family and preserved persisted data do not prove time ordering, scale/units on pixels, label readability, truthful prose or optimal chart selection.
The same model IDs/settings do not fix provider queueing, routing or stochastic behavior. Paired order is matched, but arm wall-clock windows/provider conditions can differ.
No trial rerun, metric rewrite, denominator exclusion, prompt tuning or model substitution was performed by this reporting pass.
All cases used for implementation after result disclosure must become regression cases, not remain a clean future holdout.
